related.title: Vanguard 衛星計畫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始計數、活時間、適用域遮罩及未判定資料區，不填造高通量真值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver raw counts, live time, a validity mask and unresolved intervals without inventing true high-flux values.
related.difference: 建立分日照與地影的能量帳，求電池容量及充電餘裕。
related.differenceEn: Build a sunlight/eclipsed energy ledger and determine battery capacity and charging margin.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從 m=n/(1+nτ) 代數求 n，列 m=0、400、800 s⁻¹ 的修正值。
用半小時地影算負載 0.1 Wh，再依放電效率及深度回推額定容量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Invert m=n/(1+nτ) and tabulate corrections at m=0,400,800 s⁻¹.
Compute the 0.1 Wh eclipse load and back-calculate rating through efficiency and depth of discharge.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sentinel-3 海陸環境觀測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始計數、活時間、適用域遮罩及未判定資料區，不填造高通量真值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver raw counts, live time, a validity mask and unresolved intervals without inventing true high-flux values.
related.difference: 以簡化雙通道模型估算海表溫度，追蹤大氣修正與共同校準偏差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate sea-surface temperature with a simplified two-channel model and track atmospheric correction and common calibration bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從 m=n/(1+nτ) 代數求 n，列 m=0、400、800 s⁻¹ 的修正值。
先求 2 K 通道差，再求 3 K 修正，最後求 Ts，記下模型假設。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Invert m=n/(1+nτ) and tabulate corrections at m=0,400,800 s⁻¹.
Compute the 2 K channel difference, 3 K correction and final Ts, retaining assumptions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
